evidence.summary: SASTIND and the Ministry of Education named Peking University in 2016 as one of 16 universities they co-build for 2016–2020, to support defence-specialty disciplines and majors, defence key discipline laboratories and training for the defence industry.

CASI identifies Peking University’s School of Integrated Circuits as the senior host, with Shanghai Jiao Tong University, of the national defence science and technology key laboratory for nano- and microfabrication technology, set up in 1996 to meet the defence establishment’s micro- and nano-processing needs.
